instruction: A candid documentary photograph in a medium shot captures a couple on a grassy mountain summit under an overcast sky. On the left, the man in the red striped shirt (R2) stands in profile wearing brown trousers, leaning forward slightly. On the right, the woman in the yellow cardigan (R1) stands facing him in blue jeans, smiling warmly. They hold hands gently at waist level, connecting in the center of the frame. The background features layers of misty blue mountains under a soft, diffused daylight.
elements: R2 leans forward slightly toward R1 while they hold hands
R1 faces R2 and smiles warmly during the handhold
R1 and R2 hold hands gently at waist level
their joined hands connect in the center of the frame
the couple stands on a grassy mountain summit with misty blue mountains behind them
